inv.desc_en:
REF: 7046426

Discover this incredible opportunity to transfer a clothing store in the Gràcia neighborhood of Barcelona.Inmo Olaya presents you with this excellent option to start or expand your business in one of the busiest and most touristic areas of the city.

Strategically located on a main street, this 280 m² store offers exceptional commercial visibility, with large storefronts attracting both residents and tourists exploring the area.The premises have been recently updated and distributed over two floors of equal surface area, connected by an elegant staircase.It has spaces dedicated to sales, storage, fitting rooms, offices and more, providing everything necessary to operate a successful men's clothing store.

This mid-priced clothing store has built a solid reputation in the neighborhood, with a loyal clientele spanning generations.In addition, it benefits from the growth potential thanks to the upcoming opening of more commercial spaces in the area, which guarantees a constant flow of customers.

The transfer includes everything needed to start trading immediately, with stock valued at approximately €100,000.The opportunity to continue a successful family business presents itself due to retirement, making this offer an attractive investment ready to generate income from day one.

Do not miss the opportunity to acquire this transfer for only €50,000, with a current monthly rent of €1,500 plus quarterly IBI.Contact us today for more details and take the first step towards your new business in Barcelona! At Inmo Olaya, we are here to make your business dreams come true.
